scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n fe,be -c blue,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
